construction.line: I got a job working construction
stanza: I got a job working construction
For the Johnstown Company
But lately, there ain't been much work
On account of the economy
Now all them things that seemed so important
Well, mister, they vanished right into the air
Now I just act like I don't remember
And Mary acts like she don't care
I lay back in the tall grass
And let the ants cover me
I let the jets fly
Not wishing for their destruction
Orange and black and a perfect blue sky

destruction.line: But when you talk about destruction
stanza: But when you talk about destruction
Don't you know that you can count me out?

destruction.line: Twenty years between capture and destruction
stanza: Twenty one cannon shots
Twenty years between capture and destruction
Nineteen holes
Eighteen promises

destruction.line: Here's the highway to death and destruction
stanza: Here's the highway to death and destruction
South Capitol is its name
And the school just looks like a shithole
Does that look like a nice place?
Here's the old mental institution
Now the Homeland Security Base
And here's God's Deliverance Centre
A deli called M.L.K
It was all so very painless
When you ran out to receive
All that false instruction
Which we never could believe
And now the heart is filled with gold
As if it was a purse
But, oh, what kind of love is this
Which goes from bad to worse?
You've been driving way too fast
You've been pushing way too hard
You've been taking things too far
Who do you think you are?
Maybe wait until the summertime
Maybe wait until December
Because a heartfelt seduction
Lasts a life time
